page.overview:
What is Sphinx?

Sphinx is the island in the New World where Edward Newgate was born. Unaffiliated with the World Government due to its poverty and inability to pay the Heavenly Tribute, it was previously under the protection of the Whitebeard Pirates until their disbandment and currently under one of its former members, Marco. In addition, Edward Weevil also guarded the island due to being his "father's" hometown.

Sphinx is a relatively small island that has some ruins of an old town at the shore, but its inhabitants live in another town built by Whitebeard hidden in the valley of the mountains which can only be entered through a waterfall.

Many Sphinxes live here as domesticated animals. The island has many coniferous trees and flowering shrubs, and the houses are small and have wooden roofs. The island with Whitebeard and Ace's graves is nearby.

At a certain point in the past, the World Government abandoned the island due to the poor residents' inability to pay the Heavenly Tribute, causing the island to become a lawless place, deepening their poor status. 74 years ago, Edward Newgate was born on Sphinx.
